ds_disc_1: The racking load is determined in a test with 25 kg bags on a conventional pallet racking system.
ds_disc_2: Dimensional tolerance of the pallet: +5 / −5 mm. Weight tolerance: +5 / −5 %.
ds_disc_3: We test our pallets with an evenly distributed, stable and homogeneous load of bagged goods, for a predetermined period at an ambient temperature of 20 °C. Different load conditions may lead to different results and must be assessed separately.
ds_cad: Top view and side views, dimensions in mm.
ds_cad_runner: Top view and side views of the pallet; below, the click-on runner (3 per pallet). Dimensions in mm.
ds_sim_note: Click an item number for the page and datasheet of that version.

load_ill.alt_static: Static load: three loaded pallets stacked on a flat floor. The bottom pallet carries the weight of all pallets above it.
load_ill.alt_dynamic: Dynamic load: a forklift drives with a loaded pallet. Acceleration, braking and small shocks put extra load on the pallet.
load_ill.alt_racking: Racking load: two loaded pallets in a conventional pallet rack, seen from the front at an angle. The three runners of each pallet lie across the front and the rear beam.

form_stack_hint: Pallets are ordered in full stacks. How many pallets make a stack differs per pallet: a nestable pallet comes in 45s, a medium pallet in 17s. Once you choose a pallet, the quantity goes up in steps of one stack.
